'''2002 Origins Open Justin Desai DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2002 Origins Open]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Justin "H2O" Desai (2003-05-12).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28824 KToD Senate-]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050923180818/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28824 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Event uncertain: posted May 2003 with a record across many 2002-2003 events; probably the 2003 DPC Chicago version (compare Desai's DPC Chicago sheet).<ref name="src" />
